name: typography
useFor: Use for long-form text (guides, updates, legal pages) where a component would be too much: headings H1 to H4, P for paragraphs, Lead under a page title, Muted for secondary lines, Small for captions, InlineCode for names and values, Table for a small table in text. Use Table (the component) for data.
